name: Google Sheets MCP
description: Google's official remote MCP server for Google Sheets, in Developer Preview: reads values and spreadsheet metadata, updates values and formulas, and inserts rows or columns.

skills.name: Value Reading
skills.description: Reads cell values, sheet names, grid properties, and other spreadsheet metadata.

skills.name: Value Updates
skills.description: Updates cell values and sets formulas across ranges of a spreadsheet.

skills.name: Sheet Structure
skills.description: Inserts rows or columns and runs batch structural updates on a spreadsheet.
